text: {"question":"How did the updated Hubble constant value reported in the later study differ from the baseline value presented in the earlier study, and what was the resulting significance of the tension with the CMB measurement?","reference_answer":"The later study reports a Hubble constant of 73.264 ± 0.806 km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹, which is slightly lower than the earlier baseline of 73.499 ± 0.809 km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹.
